text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kita! So today's the big day—it's<n>your
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Teio, one more time! Say that<n>again, just one
more time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That was my dream. I've always<n>wanted you to
remember my<n>birthday...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's like my dad said. You'll know<n>you've made it
when your hero<n>remembers you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Until they celebrate with you in someway, you're just another nobody.But today, you wished me a happybirthday!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hm... yeah, that's right. You've finally<n>gained my
attention, so I remembered<n>your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But you shouldn't stop here, got it?<n>You've gotta
keep getting better and<n>become my rival someday.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! Teio... hearing that<n>from you is the
greatest gift of all.<n>Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(Haha, I can't tell her that I've had it<n>memorized for
a long time now. Geez,<n>should I still give her the
karaoke mic<n>I bought?)
